<line> I was not expecting the guns.
<line> Truly, you have learned to fight fire with fire.
<line> I love this Spirit... this go-getter attitude... this willingness to take whatever you want, however you want.

passages.text:
<clue> ShootManager
<line> You finally realized that paperwork and logic were never going to work in this world.
<line> And you were fearless in your conquest of your building. You took down your Manager with no hesitation!
<line> And you come here and continue your slaughter.

passages.text:
<clue> SpareManager
<line> You refused to harm your Manager no matter how wrong she did you.
<line> I can only assume it was because you realized her usefulness to you here, correct?
<line> Every Company has its uses for incompetence. Middle Management requires it!
<line> But her use is ending. I see a new opportunity for growth.

passages.text:
<line> Of course not.
<line> Unfortunately... There is no end to this.
<line> There is no lawsuit, weapon, or power- from you alone- that could end me. I am a roach: kill one, a replacement will spawn. That is the nature of the Company.
<line> Do not bargain- you will only waste your breath.
<line> I give you two options.
[[((he's right- my gun doesn't work on him. i'll have to consider his deal))->options]]

passages.name: ((... do any of these managers or lords listen...?))

passages.text:
<line> One: Become the new Manager.
<line> You alone will be free of Roaches, for you will join the Company. They will not bother you.
<line> Be whatever kind of Manager you wish to be. You need only follow one doctrine: increase our Profits. I believe you will do us well.
<line> Two: Go home with Emily.
<line> Endure the Roaches for the rest of your putrid life.
